QuestInfo.name: [Limina] Still on the Resistance Ship
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart shared his suspicions about the 'path'. But you won't know for sure until analysis of the Core Fragment is complete. Before that, you must support the Resistance ship in #bEnd of the World 2-2#k.
QuestInfo.1: You must support the Resistance ship. Enter through the portal from #bEnd of the World 2-2#k, rescue allied soldiers, and defeat monsters.
QuestInfo.2: Now that you've provided support to the Resistance ship, talk to the soldier again in #bEnd of the World 2-2#k.
